newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Allied Group in HK$123 mln warrant plan.
newsitem.headline: Allied Group in HK$123 mln warrant plan.

text.p: Allied Group Ltd said on Wednesday it proposed to raise about HK$122.9 million before expenses by issuing not less than 614.46 million warrants to shareholders at one warrant for five shares held.

The corporate management and property development group planned to issue the warrants at HK$0.20 each with South China Capital Ltd as manager and underwriter of the deal, Allied Group said in a statement.
Warrant holders would be entitled to subscribe for new Allied Group shares on a one-for-one basis at HK$1.00 per share from March 7, 1997, to March 7, 2000, it said.
Lee and Lee Trust, which controlled about 24.69 percent of the issued share capital of Allied Group, has agreed to accept 151.69 warrants to be allocated to the company, it added.
The net proceeds of about HK$118.6 million from the issue would be used as additional working capital to expand the group's existing business.
